chunk_text: Rates and premiums for automobile insurance policies shall be determined by the application of the following rating factors in decreasing order of importance: (1) The insured's driving safety record. (2) The number of miles he or she drives annually. (3) The number of years of driving experience.

The commissioner may adopt regulations establishing additional rating factors that have a substantial relationship to the risk of loss. In no event shall credit score, zip code alone, or prohibited proxies be utilized as primary rating factors.

No rate shall be approved or remain in effect which is excessive, inadequate, unfairly discriminatory or otherwise in violation of this chapter. In considering whether a rate is excessive, the commissioner shall consider whether the rate is mathematically justified.
